question: What additional sacred configurations are revealed to the beautiful-faced goddess?
premises: An eight-spoked lotus-petaled form is named
inference: Further configurations, including an eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and a seventeenfold form, are disclosed.
uncertainties: The precise structure of ṣoḍaśaikaṃ depends on ritual context
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, there is also an eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and a sixteen-plus-one form.
